YES

The script loads all three checkpoints, verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor against both fine-tunes before writing anything, computes each task vector against the unmodified `base` dict (the merged results go into a separate `out` dict, so no aliasing corrupts the second delta), uses lambda 0.4 in float32, asserts 48 merged and 114 total, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
